## Problem

Describe the observable problem or missing contract.

## Change

Describe the implementation boundary and any public MCP, SDK, cache, or skill changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `cmake --preset release`
- [ ] `cmake --build --preset release`
- [ ] `ctest --preset release`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Tool and user documentation is updated.
- [ ] No proprietary target data, credentials, or generated build output is included.

## Compatibility and risk

List side effects, breaking changes, migrations, privilege changes, and failure modes. Write `None` when not applicable.
